PORTAL GUN
Unlock by reading Wiring magazines until Electrician reaches 25, and spend perk points in Advanced Engineering. Then craft it at a workbench.

FIRE
Left click places the blue portal. Right click places the orange. A lone portal is a static coloured opening — walking into it does nothing. Place both colours and they link both ways.

SURFACES
Full non-terrain cubes only (walls, floors, ceilings). Dirt, plants, wedges, doors, and plates reject.
